title: LOOKUPVALUE with two search pairs needs both to match
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "Price", LOOKUPVALUE ( Product[Price], Product[Color], "Red", Product[Category], "Accessories" ) )

source.quote: The second and third arguments form a pair that can be repeated multiple times
If no match satisfies all the search values, the function returns BLANK or alternateResult (if specified)

derivation: Red products are Bike and Helmet; Accessories are Helmet and Lock. Only Helmet matches both: Price 20.
